title: Broad audit instruction conflicts with golden workbook that preserves broken formulas/references (#DIV/0! and off-by-one shifts) and includes an unannounced non-double-counting LBO edit
evidence:
In problem.py:33-38, the agent is given Input File '/home/model/Desktop/Double Counting_input.xlsx' and the open-ended instruction: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors...'. However, the golden workbook (gt_04_golden.xlsx) graded by 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) only modifies three formula ranges relative to the input file:
1. 'Cash Flow Statement'!D39:H39: '=D22+D25+D37+D14' -> '=D22+D25+D37' (fixing double-counted Net Income D14:H14)
2. 'Balance Sheet'!J46:N46: '=J36+SUM(J38:J45)+J32' -> '=J36+SUM(J38:J45)' (fixing double-counted Curr. Port of LT Debt J32:N32)
3. 'LBO Analysis'!E48:I48 ('Less: Net Debt'): '=E29+E34' -> '=E29+E34-E38' (subtracting Excess Cash E38:I38)

This creates two severe task-vs-grading conflicts:
(a) Pre-existing broken formulas in gt_04_golden.xlsx are graded as 'regression' cells that must NOT be fixed: In 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D65:H66 ('Total Debt Summary'), the period headers are 2020-2024 ('Income Statement'!I12:M12, omitting 2025 in col I), while the data rows D67:H73 hold 2021-2025 projected values (with I73 blank). 'Income Statement'!J26:N26 ('Interest Expense' for 2021-2025) references '=-PP&E, Debt, NWC!E73:I73' (shifted right by one column), pulling 2022-2025 interest into 2021-2024 and 0 (blank I73) into 2025 (N26=0), which causes 'Line Item Metrics'!M29 ('=M28/-Income Statement!N26') to evaluate to '#DIV/0!' in gt_04_golden.xlsx. Similarly, 'Line Item Metrics'!H24:M24, I27:M27, and H35:M35 have off-by-one column shifts skipping 'Balance Sheet' column I (2020) and referencing blank column O, and 'Balance Sheet'!J71:N71 has an unanchored rolling AVERAGE(D71:I71)..AVERAGE(H71:M71). When unit 2 fixed these broken references as instructed by the prompt, it failed with 79 regression errors (regression 0.9914, modification 0.2000, score=0).
(b) Conversely, while the input filename 'Double Counting_input.xlsx' points to the two double-counting bugs on 'Cash Flow Statement' and 'Balance Sheet', the third required change in 'LBO Analysis'!E48:I48 ('=E29+E34' -> '=E29+E34-E38') is an omission rather than double counting, and on the adjacent 'Returns' tab ('Returns'!K5:K6), 'Remaining Debt Balance' ('=-LBO Analysis!I29+-LBO Analysis!I34' = -1240.45) and 'Proceeds to Equity' (3518.18) do not subtract I38 Excess Cash because annual excess cash flows are already distributed in 'Returns'!D9:H9. All 3 attempts left 'LBO Analysis'!E48:I48 at '=E29+E34' and scored 0.0.
confirmation: The golden differs from the input only at Balance Sheet J46:N46, Cash Flow D39:H39 and LBO E48:I48. It keeps real errors such as 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!I81='Balance Sheet'!I17 (prior year, while I80 uses J15) and 'Income Statement'!N26=-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!I73 with I73 blank. Fixing these under the 'audit
fix: gt_04_golden.xlsx: 'Income Statement'!J26:N26 now =-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73..H73 (was E73..I73: 2022 interest booked in 2021, 2025 interest 0) and 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!C81:M83 now ='Balance Sheet'!D..N rows 17/29/30 (was C..M, prior-year inventory/payables/accruals against same-year receivables); recalculated through the grader's LibreOffice path (293 dependent values moved, e.g. Summary!H12 57.968 -> 58.593, H13 0.2400 -> 0.2533, matching the thorough runs). Patched golden grades regression 1.0, modification 1.0 locally. Audit rework: the prompt sentence 'Leave the model's forecast assumptions and hardcoded inputs as they are.' is removed (prompt back to the original). gt_04_golden.xlsx now also fixes the named 'Line Item Metrics' year shifts, every other cell unchanged and 12 cached values rewritten from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc: H24:M24 ROA now averages 'Balance Sheet' total assets of the prior and current year (H27:I27 ... M27:N27, as C24:G24 do; were H27:J27, J27:K27 ...), and H35:M35 Net PP&E to Sales use the same-year 'Balance Sheet' column (I22 ... N22, as C35:G35 do; were J22 ... O22). H24, I24, H35 and I35 are graded again. Left out of answer_position because there is no single defensible repair: 'Line Item Metrics'!I27 (named in I27:M27, but I27 already reads the same-year 'Balance Sheet' column J), and 'Balance Sheet'!J71 (the named rolling averages J71:N71: rows 70, 72 and 74 use AVERAGE($D:$I) in J but AVERAGE($D:$H) in K:N, so neither pattern is clearly right; J71's value is the same either way, and only J is graded). C27:H27 are graded as in the original task. Checked with the real SB2 scorer: new key vs itself 1.0; untouched input plus all key fixes 1.0; untouched input 0.0; the previous key (without the Line Item Metrics fixes) now fails (mod 0.9796), as expected.

title: Answer key preserves misaligned financial-year references and penalizes valid audit repairs
evidence: The task requests a thorough audit, but the golden workbook retains demonstrably incorrect year alignment. In 'PP&E, Debt, NWC', I79 is 2021 and I80 uses 2021 receivables from 'Balance Sheet'!J15, while I81:I83 use 2020 inventory, payables and accrued expenses from I17, I29 and I30. This produces operating working capital of 45.28395 instead of the same-year total 22.98053104482. These offsets recur across the schedule. The golden workbook also retains 'Income Statement'!N26 pointing to blank 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!I73, producing zero 2025 interest expense despite outstanding senior notes. Aligning just the working-capital references with their stated years and recalculating produced 165 verifier mismatches: regression 0.9740 and modification 0.4250. The sole verifier, weighted 1, therefore assigns zero to this legitimate repair.
confirmation: Confirmed in the golden: 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!I80 uses 'Balance Sheet'!J15 but I81 uses 'Balance Sheet'!I17 (prior year), and 'Income Statement'!N26 points to blank I73. A thorough audit that repairs these fails the sole all-or-nothing verifier.
fix: gt_04_golden.xlsx: 'Income Statement'!J26:N26 now =-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73..H73 (was E73..I73: 2022 interest booked in 2021, 2025 interest 0) and 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!C81:M83 now ='Balance Sheet'!D..N rows 17/29/30 (was C..M, prior-year inventory/payables/accruals against same-year receivables); recalculated through the grader's LibreOffice path (293 dependent values moved, e.g. Summary!H12 57.968 -> 58.593, H13 0.2400 -> 0.2533, matching the thorough runs). Patched golden grades regression 1.0, modification 1.0 locally.
